title: secale strictum subsp. chaldicum
intro: Secale strictum subsp. chaldicum, commonly known as rye grass, is a plant species within the genus Secale. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including lowering cholesterol levels and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of rye grass include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to alleviate symptoms of various conditions. The bioactive constituents of rye grass include ferulic acid, 5-hydroxymethylfurfural, and other phenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
